abstract: This study systematically investigates the structure and electrochemical properties of poly(pentyl malonate) (PPM) and its derivatives as electrolytes for <mark>lithium</mark> batteries from a molecular design perspective. Density functional theory (DFT) is employed to reveal the coordination mechanism of Li+ in PPM electrolytes, and the underlying reason for the high ion transference number of PPM is explained at the microstructural level.
